o: O is a nonmetallic bivalent element that is normally a colorless odorless tasteless nonflammable diatomic gas.
O can also mean the 15th letter of the Roman alphabet.
O can also mean the blood group whose red cells carry neither the A nor B antigens.
O means the same as oxygen or atomic number 8 or type O.
o'brien: O'Brien means the same as Edna O'Brien.
o'casey: O'Casey means the same as Sean O'Casey.
o'connor: O'Connor means the same as Flannery O'Connor or Mary Flannery O'Connor.
o'flaherty: O'Flaherty is Irish writer of short stories.
O'Flaherty means the same as Liam O'Flaherty.
o'hara: O'Hara means the same as John Henry O'Hara.
o'keeffe: O'Keeffe means the same as Georgia Okeeffe.
o'neill: O'Neill means the same as Eugene O'Neill or Eugene Gladstone O'Neill.
o'toole: O'Toole means the same as Peter O'Toole or Peter Seamus O'Toole.
o. henry: O. Henry is United States writer of short stories whose pen name was O. Henry.
O. Henry means the same as Porter or William Sydney Porter.
O.E.D. is an unabridged dictionary constructed on historical principles.
O.E.D. means the same as Oxford English Dictionary or OED.
O.K. means being satisfactory or in satisfactory condition.
O.K. can also mean an endorsement.
O.K. can also mean in a satisfactory or adequate manner.

o level: O level is the basic level of a subject taken in school.
O level means the same as General Certificate of Secondary Education or GCSE.
o ring: O ring is a gasket consisting of a flat ring of rubber or plastic.
To o.d. means to dose too heavily.
For example: "The rock star overdosed and was found dead in his hotel room."
O.d. means the same as overdose.
o'clock: O'clock means according to the clock.
For example: "It's three o'clock in Tokyo now."
o'er: O'er means throughout a period of time.
O'er means the same as over.
